Class SocketClient

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.network.socket.client.SocketClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer
public final class SocketClient extends Object implements VirtualServer
Client-side socket transport. Implements VirtualServer by serializing each request into a typed Message and shipping it over an ObjectOutputStream. Incoming server callbacks are dispatched to the local VirtualView by a dedicated reader thread.

    • ping

      public void ping()
      Heartbeat ping used by the client to detect server availability.

      No-op on the socket transport: the reader loop already detects connection drops, so no application-level ping is needed.

      Specified by:
      ping in interface VirtualServer
